reuse.why: Extends the existing assertBankAccountNotLinked guard used by both link paths and extracts the unlink field-reset into releaseAccountLinks, which unlinkAccount now also uses.

duplication.why: The unlink reset that would otherwise be copied is moved into one helper shared with unlinkAccount; only the two-line call pair is repeated in the two link functions, mirroring the existing structure.

placement.why: All logic stays in accounts/app.ts next to the existing link guard, save and unlink helpers.

scope.why: Only the flag, the guard, the shared release helper, tests and a release note are touched.

maintainability.why: Clean and small, though assertBankAccountNotLinked now both asserts and returns holder ids, so its name no longer describes its role.
